result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 1 FOUND, 4 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Static review of scoped application code, WCF configuration, Dockerfile and Compose definitions; no credential values included.
Checked-in local-container demonstration credentials were excluded under the review's sample/development credential exception; no operational non-demo secret established.
No cryptographic key use identified. Missing general logging alone was not elevated to an exploitable security finding.

Deployment-level IIS authentication, network ACLs and external audit facilities were not runtime-verified. The access-control finding applies to supplied defaults without additional external controls.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

evidence.explanation: The supplied WCF endpoint uses basicHttpBinding with default security settings and no configured authentication/authorization checks. ICatalogService exposes CreateAvailableStock, CreateCatalogItem, UpdateCatalogItem and RemoveCatalogItem as OperationContracts. CatalogService.UpdateCatalogItem marks the caller-supplied entity Modified at lines 73-76 and saves it without checking caller identity or permissions; other mutation operations likewise persist caller data. Compose publishes the service on host port 5113. A caller able to reach the supplied default endpoint can issue SOAP mutation requests to alter catalog prices/descriptions and stock without application credentials. External IIS authentication or network isolation could constrain reachability but is not configured in the scoped deployment files.

values.name: Insufficient Logging
values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
